note: Subject layer of direction A (Lime, sand and hazard paint) of the Goblin redesign study, bead pulp_wars-wrn.1. Exploration only; see docs/art/factions/GOBLIN_REDESIGN.md.

subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER: Subject: Goblin, a chunky cute scrappy little goblin raider with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body leaning forward, the head and ears filling the whole width of the image: bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, with lighter #acdc55 on the face, nose and belly and darker #5a9424 shading, two huge pointed ears sticking straight out sideways, a long pointy nose, big cream eyes with black pupils and a wide toothy grin, a small pale sand-buff leather cap, a bare chest with one pale sand-buff strap, a short pale sand-buff loincloth, a dark brown belt, an oversized jagged light grey tin cleaver with a hazard yellow painted handle held up in the right hand, big bare lime green feet; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a sneaky little stabber, not a soldier with a shield.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER: Subject: Wolf Rider, a chunky cute little goblin riding a big shaggy wolf, wide and low, filling the whole width of the image: the wolf is light ash grey with a cream belly, chest and muzzle, a big head with pointed ears, a long snout with an open grin and small cream fangs, four chunky light grey legs and paws; a pale sand-buff patched hide saddle blanket on its back; the goblin rider has bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, shaded #5a9424, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a pale sand-buff leather cap and strap, and waves a short light grey tin spear with a small hazard yellow rag tied below the blade; simple shapes and very few details; the wolf's paws are the lowest thing in the image; clearly wolf cavalry, not a horse.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Bomb Chucker, a chunky cute little goblin bomb thrower with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a small body, the head and ears filling the whole width of the image: bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, with lighter #acdc55 on the face and darker #5a9424 shading, huge pointed ears, a big excited grin, a dented tin pot helmet painted hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f, with one black stripe and round goggles pushed up on it, a bare chest with two crossed pale sand-buff straps, a pale sand-buff loincloth, the right arm raised high holding one big round black bomb above the head with a short fuse and a bright spark, a bulging pale sand-buff satchel on the hip, dark brown boots; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a bomb thrower, not an archer.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:GUARD: Subject: Orc Brute, a chunky cute big broad orc with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a wide heavy body filling the whole width of the image: mid green skin, colour #4a8a3a, with lighter #6faa55 on the face, jaw, chest and belly and darker #326426 shading, a heavy jaw with two cream tusks, a flat nose, small grumpy eyes under a heavy brow, the whole face clearly visible, a small dented light grey tin cap on top of the head, a bare chest with a pale sand-buff leather harness and a sand-buff hide kilt, a big round light grey tin shield with a thick hazard yellow painted rim held on the left arm, a huge chunky light grey tin cleaver in the right hand, dark brown boots, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a big shield bruiser.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Orc Warboss, a chunky cute big bossy orc chief with a huge round head about half of the figure's height and a broad stocky body: mid green skin, colour #4a8a3a, with lighter #6faa55 on the face and chest and darker #326426 shading, a big face fully visible with a wide open shouting mouth, two cream tusks and angry eyebrows, a small light grey tin helmet sitting high on the head with two big curved cream horns and no visor, a short pale sand-buff hide mantle with a cream fur collar over the shoulders only, a bare chest with a sand-buff harness and kilt, a big tin megaphone painted hazard yellow held out to the side, away from the face, in the right hand, the left fist raised; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a yelling war chief.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute rickety home-made goblin fireworks cart, clearly bigger than a soldier: a roped bundle of five fat paper fireworks rockets on thin sticks standing up in the cart and leaning forward, paper tubes in red, orange, hazard yellow, blue and green, each with a cream paper cone tip, one fuse lit with a bright spark; the cart is weathered grey-tan planks on two wooden wheels with light grey tin rims; a little goblin with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, huge pointed ears and a pale sand-buff cap leans out of the cart holding a lit match; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a home-made fireworks cart, not a catapult.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT: Subject: Scrap Buggy, a chunky cute rickety spiky jalopy, wide and low, filling the whole width of the image: a boxy body of bolted light grey tin panels with rivets, two big panels painted hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f, with black diagonal stripes, a big spiked light grey tin ram on the front, four mismatched chunky black wheels with light grey hubs, a crooked tin exhaust pipe puffing a round light grey smoke cloud; a little goblin driver with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a pale sand-buff flying cap and round goggles grips a small steering wheel; simple shapes and very few details; the wheels are the lowest thing in the image; clearly a war buggy, not a cart.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Troll, a chunky cute giant mossy troll, a huge hulking hunched lump much wider and taller than a normal soldier: a big round head sunk forward between enormous shoulders, sage green skin, colour #739a59, with a big pale cream-green #cde0b4 belly, chest and face and darker #4c6c3c shading on the back and arms, a few light moss tufts on the head and shoulders, a huge drooping nose, tiny eyes and a goofy underbite with two cream tusks, very long arms reaching down to the knees, a huge knobbly light grey stone club resting on the right shoulder, a pale sand-buff patched hide loincloth, light grey tin wrist bands, big bare sage green feet, wide braced stance; simple shapes and very few details; clearly a friendly giant, not a normal soldier.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:FIGHTER: Subject: Goblin portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute scrappy little goblin raider: a huge round head with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, lighter #acdc55 on the face and darker #5a9424 shading, two huge pointed ears sticking straight out sideways, a long pointy nose, big cream eyes and a wide toothy grin, a small pale sand-buff leather cap, bare lime green shoulders with a sand-buff strap, the tip of a jagged light grey tin cleaver with a hazard yellow handle; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:RAIDER: Subject: Wolf Rider portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little goblin rider with the big head of his light ash grey wolf beside him: bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, shaded #5a9424, huge pointed ears, a big grin, a pale sand-buff leather cap and strap; the wolf has a cream muzzle, pointed ears and small cream fangs; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:MARKSMAN: Subject: Bomb Chucker portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute little goblin bomb thrower: a huge round head with bright lime green skin, colour #86c232, shaded #5a9424, huge pointed ears, a big excited grin, a dented tin pot helmet painted hazard yellow, colour #fdd20f, with one black stripe and round goggles, pale sand-buff straps on bare shoulders, one big round black bomb with a bright spark held up beside the head; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:GUARD: Subject: Orc Brute portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute big broad orc: a huge round head with mid green skin, colour #4a8a3a, lighter #6faa55 on the face and jaw, a heavy jaw, two cream tusks, small grumpy eyes, the whole face clearly visible under a small light grey tin cap, a pale sand-buff harness on bare shoulders, the top of a round light grey tin shield with a hazard yellow rim; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CAPTAIN: Subject: Orc Warboss portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute big bossy orc chief: a huge round head with mid green skin, colour #4a8a3a, lighter #6faa55 on the face, the face fully visible with a wide open shouting mouth, two cream tusks and angry eyebrows, a small light grey tin helmet sitting high on the head with two big curved cream horns, a pale sand-buff hide mantle with a cream fur collar, a hazard yellow megaphone held beside the face; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:CATAPULT: Subject: Rocket Cart, a chunky cute home-made goblin fireworks cart shown whole: a roped bundle of fat paper fireworks rockets in red, orange, hazard yellow, blue and green with cream paper cone tips, one fuse lit, on a small rickety cart of weathered grey-tan planks with two wheels with light grey tin rims, a little lime green goblin with a lit match; simple shapes and very few details; clearly fireworks, not a missile.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:KNIGHT: Subject: Scrap Buggy, a chunky cute rickety spiky jalopy shown whole, wide and low: a boxy body of light grey tin panels with two hazard yellow and black striped panels, a big spiked tin ram on the front, chunky black wheels, a crooked exhaust pipe with a light grey smoke cloud and a little goblin driver with bright lime green skin, a pale sand-buff cap and goggles; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:JUGGERNAUT: Subject: Troll portrait, head and shoulders of a chunky cute giant mossy troll: a big round head with sage green skin, colour #739a59, a pale cream-green #cde0b4 face and chest, darker #4c6c3c shading, light moss tufts, a huge drooping nose, tiny eyes and a goofy underbite with two cream tusks, enormous shoulders, the top of a light grey stone club; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:1: Subject: a small level-1 goblin scrap camp: three chunky round patched tents of pale sand-buff hide with darker stitched patches, one hut of light grey tin sheets with a hazard yellow painted door and a bent chimney pipe, and a crooked grey-tan wooden lookout pole with a small basket platform and no flag. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:2: Subject: a level-2 goblin scrap camp, clearly bigger than a small camp, with no castle and no stone: big round patched tents of pale sand-buff hide, a hut of light grey tin sheets with hazard yellow painted panels, a riveted light grey tin lookout tower on grey-tan planks with no flag, a chimney pipe with a small light grey smoke cloud, a low spiked tin fence. Buildings only.
subjects.CITY:GOBLIN:3: Subject: a large level-3 goblin scrap camp, the biggest settlement, with no castle and no stone: one huge patched tent of pale sand-buff hide with a bare pole, small sand-buff tents, four huts of light grey tin sheets with hazard yellow painted roofs and grey-tan plank doors, three chimney pipes with light grey smoke, a spiked tin fence. Buildings only.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Goblins, a chunky cute small ramshackle junk-boat seen from the front-right: a lopsided hull of weathered grey-tan planks patched with riveted light grey tin plates, one crooked mast with one big patched pale sand-buff sail with one hazard yellow patch, a small barrel on deck and one paper firework rocket tied to the mast, and a little bright lime green goblin with huge pointed ears peeking over the rail; simple shapes and very few details; silly, never grim.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Goblins, a chunky cute big ramshackle scrap warship seen from the front-right: a tall lopsided hull of weathered grey-tan planks and riveted light grey tin plates with hazard yellow painted stripes, a tin lookout tower, two crooked masts with big patched pale sand-buff sails, barrels on deck and a rack of paper firework rockets, and a little bright lime green goblin with huge pointed ears; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.UNIT:GOBLIN:EMBARKED_TRANSPORT: Subject: Embarked transport of the Goblins, a chunky cute wide ramshackle raft seen from the front-right, no mast and no sail: grey-tan logs and planks lashed together with rope, patched with light grey tin plates, two crooked oars, a heap of cargo and barrels under a patched pale sand-buff tarp, a short pole with a hazard yellow rag; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT: Subject: Patrol Boat of the Goblins, a chunky cute small ramshackle junk-boat shown whole from the front-right: weathered grey-tan planks patched with light grey tin, one big patched pale sand-buff sail with a hazard yellow patch, a little bright lime green goblin with huge pointed ears; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
subjects.PORTRAIT:GOBLIN:BATTLESHIP: Subject: Battleship of the Goblins, a chunky cute big ramshackle scrap warship shown whole from the front-right: grey-tan planks and light grey tin plates with hazard yellow stripes, two patched pale sand-buff sails, a tin lookout tower and paper firework rockets; no water; simple shapes and very few details.
